title: Drone Design Engineer — CAD & Prototyping
description: About OneSec: OneSec is making food delivery 3 times faster and 10 times cheaper, by developing small AI powered delivery drones. Visit our website for more info: www.OneSec.com Role Overview: We’re looking for a hands-on Drone Design Engineer to design, prototype, assemble, and test mechanical components for our autonomous delivery drones. You will work across the full product-development cycle, turning concepts into detailed SolidWorks models, producing parts using 3D printing and other manufacturing methods, assembling physical prototypes, and improving designs based on real-world testing. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys both CAD design and practical workshop work and wants to see their designs become real flying hardware. Key Responsibilities: Design mechanical parts and assemblies for autonomous delivery drones Create detailed 3D models and technical drawings in SolidWorks Design airframe components, mounts, enclosures, payload mechanisms, flaps, and propulsion-system interfaces Produce prototypes using FDM and resin 3D printing, CNC machining, composites, and other fabrication methods Assemble, modify, repair, and test physical drone prototypes Select suitable materials, fasteners, bearings, adhesives, and manufacturing processes Improve designs for weight, strength, stiffness, manufacturability, and ease of assembly Investigate mechanical failures and rapidly redesign components Work closely with propulsion, electronics, embedded-software, and flight-control engineers Maintain and improve CAD assemblies, drawings, and mechanical documentation Qualifications: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, Product Design, or a related technical field Strong SolidWorks or equivalent CAD skills Experience designing parts that have been physically manufactured and assembled Familiarity with FDM or resin 3D printing and rapid prototyping Comfortable using workshop tools such as drills, Dremels, saws, adhesives, and hand tools Good understanding of mechanical design, materials, tolerances, fasteners, and manufacturing methods Experience with drones, robotics, lightweight structures, composites, or aerospace systems is a plus Strong problem-solving skills and a practical, hands-on approach Why You’ll Love Working Here Design, build, and test real flying hardware Work with an exceptionally talented team Work on cutting edge drone & AI technology Take ownership of projects from CAD model to physical prototype Good compensation Equity participation (Stock options)

title: Manufacturing Engineering Engineer
description: About the Company For over 100 years, Neapco has been a leading global provider of innovative driveline solutions for a wide variety of applications. Constantly evolving with changing markets and driveline technologies, Neapco provides leading-edge propshafts/driveshafts, sideshafts/halfshafts, differentials, aluminum die castings and driveline components to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), driveline specialists and major heavy-duty parts distributors. Neapco’s capabilities feature a deeply experienced in-house engineering staff, automated lean manufacturing processes, and ongoing quality improvement. A trusted source of engineered solutions for all classes of vehicles and stationary driveline applications, Neapco is known industrywide for flexibility, innovation and on-time delivery. Neapco driveline products are used in commercial vehicles including over-the-road heavy trucks, busses, fire engines and light duty vans, as well as recreational vehicles (RVs) and large motor homes. Neapco provides a full line of fixed-length assemblies and many styles of yokes to interface with other driveline components. Neapco’s flexible engineering and production capabilities can deliver solutions ranging from short-run custom and standard configurations to high-volume OEM assemblies. Widely specified in all commercial vehicle applications, Neapco precision products provide competitively priced OEM quality and performance. About the Role The Manufacturing Engineering Engineer oversees the development and implementation of manufacturing processes which maintain proper product functionality as well as cost efficiency. Responsibilities Provide sustainability of the production performance and quality. Work closely with specialists and operators in the shopfloor to ensure the efficiency of the manufaturing lines. Manage daily Process Audits. Coordinate product and process launches using APQP procedures and principles. Ensure that the manufacturing process is established with equipment, tooling, and process controls that can meet customer, risk, and operation targets. Manage through direct reports, the implementation of the PM system and the maintenance and repair of new equipment and tooling and the related physical plant in those areas through launch up until Production assumes responsibility. Monitor and plan equipment and tooling capacity. Maintain environmental regulatory compliance. Take role in establishing a capital budget and expense budget for management approval. Ensure that the applicable standard practices are understood and applied. Maintain metrics on: equipment and tooling capacity utilization, regulatory conformance, launch conformance, process performance, process control, PM performance, and labour standards conformance. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering Minimum of three (3) years of Manufacturing Engineering experience in an automotive parts manufacturing environment. Required Skills Proficiency in English is a must. Knowledge and understanding of CI tools and approaches (lean manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, problem solving, Kanban, process mapping, etc.). Experience with IATF 16949. Experience with structured APQP process. Experience with AIAG VDA P-FMEA. Experience on FANUC and/or SIEMENS programming. Understanding and application of SPC/process control. AutoCAD and Minitab (or other statistical package). Please send us your application preferably in English if you believe that you are the right candidate. Equal Opportunity Statement Neapco recognizes that our team members are our most valuable asset, and we are committed to providing them with a safe, drug-free workplace fostering respect and ethical treatment. Unlawful discrimination in employment decisions based on race, color, religion, ethnic/national origin, age, sex, veteran status, disability, or any similar protected status is strictly prohibited. www.neapco.com

Bu yolculukta başarımızı teknoloji ile beraber değerlerimizden de alıyoruz: adaletle güven inşa ediyor, birlikte mükemmelliği hedefliyor, kapsayıcı bir ortam kuruyor, yenilikçi bakış açısıyla büyüyor ve sorumluluk bilinciyle hareket ediyoruz. Sen de geniş öğrenme imkanlarıyla sınırsız gelişimi planlıyor; yenilikçi ve öncü projelerle başarılı bir kariyer hedefliyorsan aramızdaki yerini hemen al! #GücünOdağındaSenVarsın TEI'de Seni Neler Bekliyor? description: Calpabot is an early-stage humanoid robotics startup building practical robotic systems for real-world work. You’ll work hands-on with the physical system, selecting, integrating, testing and iterating the components that make the robot move. What you’ll work on • Actuator, BLDC motor and motor driver integration • CAN bus communication and hardware interfaces • Sensors, encoders and feedback systems • Battery, BMS and power distribution architecture • Wiring, connectors and electrical integration • Hardware bring-up, testing and troubleshooting • Component selection and prototype BOM development • Integration with mechanical design and robotics software What we’re looking for • Background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical Engineering or a related field • Hands-on experience with motors, actuators, sensors or embedded hardware • Familiarity with CAN bus and hardware communication protocols • Ability to prototype, test and debug real hardware • Comfortable building from first principles and working with incomplete information • Strong ownership mentality and genuine interest in robotics About the founding team Calpabot is being founded by an experienced software and systems architect with a background in building and leading large-scale technology products. Mechanical and industrial design is being developed as part of the founding engineering team. We are currently at the early prototype stage , defining the architecture, selecting components and preparing the first physical system. About the role This is a Co-Founder position, not a conventional salaried job . The role can initially be pursued alongside your current work. Equity will be structured through vesting and clearly defined milestones . Prototype hardware, actuators, electronics and development materials required for the project will be provided. The team is based in Istanbul , and because this is a hardware project, regular in-person prototype work will be necessary. Our immediate objective is straightforward: build our first functional prototype. If you want to build real robotic hardware from the ground up and take ownership of a core part of the technology and company, we’d like to hear from you. calpabot.com

title: Mekanikkonstruktör
description: Vill du arbeta i teknikens framkant och bidra till utvecklingen av morgondagens produkter? Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta nära kunder, delta i spännande projekt och skapa smarta tekniska lösningar. Om rollen I rollen som mekanikkonstruktör arbetar du nära våra kunder och utvecklingsteam för att ta fram smarta, hållbara och affärsmässiga konstruktionslösningar. En viktig del i rollen är att fungera som länken mellan design och produktion för att säkerställa att idéer och koncept blir tillverkningsbara och funktionella slutprodukter. Projekten varierar i både omfattning och tekniskt innehåll och sträcker sig över flera branscher och teknikområden. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Arbeta med mekanisk konstruktion i både mindre och större utvecklingsprojekt. Utveckla innovativa tekniska lösningar utifrån kundernas behov och krav. Agera som en viktig länk mellan design och produktion för att optimera konstruktion och tillverkningsbarhet. Ta fram modeller, koncept och konstruktionsunderlag för nya produkter och funktioner. Utföra hållfasthetsberäkningar och tekniska analyser. Välja lämpliga material och tillverkningsmetoder med fokus på kvalitet, funktion och kostnadseffektivitet. Driva och delta i kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete (Continuous Improvement) inom utvecklings- och konstruktionsprocessen. Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med bland annat elektronik-, hård- och mjukvaruutvecklare, testingenjörer, produktion och projektledare. Delta genom hela utvecklingsprocessen, från idé och koncept till färdig lösning och produktionsstart. title: Senior Structural Engineer
description: Haluatko ratkoa teknisesti vaativia suunnitteluhaasteita ja vaikuttaa siihen, millaisia tuotteita, rakenteita ja ratkaisuja teollisuudessa kehitetään? Haemme lujuuslaskijoita useisiin eri kokemustason rooleihin osaksi teknisen laskennan asiantuntijaorganisaatiotamme. Etsimme lujuuslaskennan erikoisosaajia Tampereen, Espoon, Lappeenrannan, Oulun, Turun, Jyväskylän ja Kuopion toimipisteisiimme. Työssäsi toimit vastuullisena teknisen laskennan asiantuntijana ja osallistut projektista riippuen rakenteiden analysointiin, simulointien suunnitteluun, tulosten tulkintaan sekä suunnitteluratkaisujen kehittämiseen yhteistyössä asiakkaidemme ja muiden asiantuntijoidemme kanssa. Ensisijaisesti haemme asiantuntijoita, joilla on jo aiempaa työkokemusta ja halua olla mukana kehittämässä simuloinnin avulla uusia teknologioita ja toimintatapoja yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa. Tukenasi toimii kokenut ja motivoitunut laskentaryhmämme, joka uskoo yhteistyön voimaan asiantuntijatehtävissä. Aiemmasta kokemuksestasi riippuen voi työtehtäväsi olla myös senior/lead engineer tai voit olla lähiaikoina ottamassa kasvuaskelta näihin rooleihin. Vaikka haemmekin ensisijaisesti jo kokemusta omaavia laskijoita, myös uran alkuvaiheessa olevat hakijat huomioidaan tapauskohtaisesti. Laskentaprojektimme liittyvät pääasiallisesti koneenrakennusteollisuuden tarpeisiin - meillä laskijat pääsevät haastamaan itseään hyvin laaja-alaisesti useilla teollisuuden alueilla. Projekteissamme tehdään laskentaa ja simulointia koneenrakennuksen sovellusten lisäksi mm. elektronisille laitteille, rakennesuunnitteluun, laivanrakennuksen haasteisiin ja laitossuunnittelun tarpeisiin. Hyödynnämme suunnittelussa ja laskennassa aktiivisesti moderneja AI-työkaluja ja tekoälyavusteisia optimointimenetelmiä. Osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi Soveltuva teknisen alan koulutus: DI/TkT (lujuustekniikan syventävät opinnot) Senior ja Lead -rooleihin useamman vuoden kokemusta teollisuuden lujuuslaskentatehtävistä, mielellään koneensuunnittelun alalta. Huomioimme myös uransa alkuvaiheessa olevat hakijat ja rakennamme roolin osaamisen sekä kokemuksen mukaan. Kokemusta FEM-laskennasta ja nykyaikaisista simulointityökaluista sekä kykyä arvioida laskentamallien luotettavuutta, analysoida tuloksia ja muodostaa niiden pohjalta perusteltuja teknisiä johtopäätöksiä. Kyky työskennellä vaihtelevassa ja dynaamisessa projektiympäristössä Hyvä suullinen sekä kirjallinen suomen- ja englanninkielen taito Arvostamme myös Kokemusta joltakin lujuuslaskennan erityisosaamisalueelta, kuten väsymislaskennasta, dynamiikasta, värähtelyistä, epälineaarisesta laskennasta, murtumismekaniikasta, lämpöjännitysanalyyseistä tms. Standardi- ja määräysympäristöjen tuntemusta (esim. painelaitteet, Eurocode tai muut rakenteelliseen mitoitukseen liittyvät standardit) Kiinnostusta laskentamenetelmien kehittämiseen, automatisointiin, ohjelmointiin tai skriptaukseen Kokemusta asiakasrajapinnassa työskentelystä tai teknisten ratkaisujen esittämisestä eri sidosryhmille Halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi sekä jakaa asiantuntemustasi muille Tarjoamme urakehitysmahdollisuuksia monipuolisten ja teknisesti haastavien lujuuslaskentaprojektien parissa useilla teollisuudenaloilla, kilpailukykyiset edut ja ison yrityksen kokonaisvaltaisen tuen. Kokeneena laskijana pääset syventämään osaamistasi laskennan eri osa-alueilla ja kehittymään sinua kiinnostavan alan erityisasiantuntijaksi. Lead / Senior Engineer -roolissa saat enemmän vastuuta laskentaorganisaation toiminnasta ja projektimyynnistä. Rakennamme työtehtävät, vastuun ja kehittymismahdollisuudet osaamisesi sekä kiinnostuksenkohteidesi mukaan. Meillä on rento yrityskulttuuri, jossa teemme töitä yhdessä kunnianhimoisesti ammattimaisella asenteella – jos haluat päästä kehittymään teknisen laskennan huippuasiantuntijaksi ja perehtyä monipuolisesti eri teollisuudenalojen laskentahaasteisiin, tarjoamme tähän parhaan mahdollisen ympäristön! Tämän tehtävän palkkahaitari on (melko) laaja, sillä olemme valmiita palkkaamaan sekä uransa alkuvaiheessa olevia että kokeneempia ammattilaisia. Meille tärkeintä on löytää oikea osaaminen ja sopivuus tehtävään sekä varmistaa, että rooli ja palkkaus vastaavat toisiaan. Etteplan on työpaikka ammattilaisille, joita motivoivat teknologia ja innovatiivisuus. Olemme ylpeitä osaamisestamme ja siitä, että pystymme vaikuttamaan asiakkaidemme menestykseen. Meidän matkassamme sinulla on mahdollisuus syventää osaamistasi haasteellisten ja monipuolisten työtehtävien parissa. Tuemme myös työntekijöidemme työn ja vapaa-ajan välistä tasapainoa, mikä tarkoittaa myös mahdollisuutta osittaiseen etätyöskentelyyn. Nämä ja monet muut edut odottavat sinua Etteplanilla!

title: Ingénieur(e) calcul en mécanique des structures
description: Arabelle Solutions : Bâtissons l'avenir de l'énergie nucléaire ensemble ! Contexte Général Travaillant au sein de l’équipe « Technology » de l’ingénierie Produit, l’ingénieur(e) calcul pour l’intégrité mécanique devra réaliser des études statiques et dynamiques des composants et assemblages des produits nucléaires, et contribuera au développement des outils et méthodes associés. Les produits nucléaires incluent la turbine à vapeur, les échangeurs thermiques, l’alternateur, les pompes et leurs systèmes auxiliaires. Ce rôle consiste principalement à évaluer l’intégrité mécanique de produits nucléaires (turbine, alternateur, pompes, échangeurs de chaleur, etc.) et à développer des méthodes et outils pour les analyses d’intégrité mécanique statique, dynamique et thermomécanique. Les Principales Activités Sont Les Suivantes Réaliser des analyses d’intégrité mécanique par la méthode des éléments finis sur des composants, conformément aux critères de dimensionnement et aux règles et instructions internes. Modéliser des structures complexes à l’aide du logiciel de maillage HyperMesh et effectuer des simulations par éléments finis sous ANSYS. Personnaliser les modèles, automatiser les cas de charge et effectuer des post-traitements avancés à l’aide du langage APDL (Ansys Parametric Design Language). Réaliser des analyses statiques et dynamiques (modales, sismiques, harmoniques, transitoires), ainsi que des études de durée de vie (fatigue, nocivité, propagation de fissures). Effectuer des calculs mécaniques linéaires et non linéaires (non-linéarités de contact, de comportement matériau et de géométrie). Intégrer les exigences des codes (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M) dans les études de dimensionnement des appareils à pression. Prendre en charge les analyses mécaniques dans le cadre de l’exécution des projets et/ou du développement produit. Rédiger les rapports d’analyse d’intégrité mécanique conformément aux exigences qualité et aux plannings définis. Vérifier les calculs et analyses réalisés par d’autres membres de l’équipe. Assurer le suivi technique des activités sous-traitées. Contribuer au développement et à l’harmonisation des outils, processus de calcul et à la capitalisation du savoir-faire. Respecter les règles et instructions EHS propres à l’entreprise. Profil recherché Diplôme d’ingénieur ou doctorat dans le domaine du calcul d’intégrité mécanique. Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine du calcul mécanique de structures par éléments finis. Excellente maîtrise des outils ANSYS (APDL) et HyperMesh ; la connaissance de CATIA est un atout. Bonne connaissance des codes et standards applicables aux appareils à pression (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M). Connaissance des machines tournantes Capacité à lire, analyser et interpréter des plans de fabrication et des documents d’ingénierie. Aptitude à travailler dans un environnement motivant et exigeant. Leadership et capacité à piloter des activités techniques complexes. Bon relationnel, esprit d’équipe et capacité à représenter le service dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements occasionnels en France ou à l’étranger (principalement en Europe). Bon niveau d’anglais. Pourquoi Nous Rejoindre Contribuer activement à la transition énergétique en participant au développement de solutions bas carbone utilisées dans un tiers des centrales nucléaires mondiales Évoluer au sein d’un leader industriel adossé au groupe EDF, offrant des projets d’envergure internationale et des perspectives de carrière solides Rejoindre une équipe d’experts reconnus et travailler sur des problématiques techniques complexes et innovantes en calcul d’intégrité mécanique Avoir un impact concret sur des équipements critiques (turbines, alternateurs, pompes) grâce à des analyses avancées et au développement d’outils et méthodes S’épanouir dans une culture fondée sur l’esprit d’équipe, l’expertise et l’engagement, dans un environnement multiculturel et stimulant Nos Avantages Rémunération fixe sur 13 mois, complétée par une part variable. Prime d’intéressement. Prise en charge à 100 % des transports publics. Plan d’épargne salariale et retraite supplémentaire. Mutuelle d'entreprise prise en charge à 65 %. Accès aux avantages du CSE (chèques vacances, réductions, actions culturelles, etc.). Prêt e à relever ce défi ? Rejoignez Arabelle Solutions et contribuez à bâtir un avenir énergétique plus propre et plus sûr ! Join us and work with global teams to support global customers ! At Arabelle Solutions, we have team members of more than 49 nationalities spread across 16 countries. At Arabelle Solutions, we know diversity makes teams and business stronger.

title: Ingenjör inom Additiv tillverkning
description: BAE Systems Hägglunds AB Vill du arbeta inom försvarsindustrin och dessutom för en världsledande fordonstillverkare? Just nu befinner sig BAE Systems Hägglunds AB i en expansiv fas inom samtliga produktområden, då efterfrågan på Hägglunds fordon (Bandvagn / BVS10 och Stridsfordon 90 / CV90) nått höjder som aldrig tidigare har skådats. Är du redo att ta klivet in i framtidens teknik? Vi söker nu en Ingenjör inom Additive Manufacturing, AM. Var med och forma framtidens industri! Din framtida utmaning Additive Manufacturing – Framtidens Teknik och Innovation! Är du en passionerad och driven ingenjör som vill vara med och forma framtidens teknik? Som Ingenjör inom AM kommer du att spela en central roll i utvecklingen och effektiviseringen av vår additiva tillverkning. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med den senaste teknologin inom 3D-printing och ingå i hela designprocessen för att skapa innovativa lösningar. Som Ingenjör inom AM har du en tongivande roll i att utveckla och optimera våra teknologiska lösningar inom additiv tillverkning. Du kommer att arbeta nära vårt designteam, där du kommer att driva hela designprocessen från idé till färdig produkt. Din erfarenhet inom konstruktion, hållfasthet och programmering kommer vara avgörande för att säkerställa att alla projekt uppfyller våra höga krav på kvalitet och effektivitet. En spännande och framtidsinriktad arbetsmiljö där innovation och teknik står i fokus. Möjligheten att arbeta med den senaste teknologin inom additiv tillverkning. En roll där du verkligen kan påverka och forma utvecklingen av nya lösningar. Stöd från ett kompetent team och en stark kultur av samarbete och lärande. En dynamisk arbetsplats där effektivisering och utveckling är nyckelkomponenter i vår strategi. Den du är Konstruktionskompetens Förståelse för materialens hållfasthet Är van vid att arbeta med programmering och koder för att optimera designen för 3D-printing. Kunskap inom CNC och maskinbearbetning värderas högt Du kan arbeta inom etablerade riktlinjer och processer, samtidigt som du driver innovation och effektivisering i hela designflödet. Vill vara med och utveckla nästa generations 3D-printers och applicera teknologin för att lösa framtidens utmaningar. Flytande i svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift Vad du blir en del av Hos oss kommer du att ha kul på jobbet och ingen dag kommer att vara den andra lik! title: New Product Introduction Engineer
description: About the job Company Description Millux BV is a leading expert in advanced metals processing, laser micromachining, and high‑precision laser welding for demanding semiconductor and high‑tech applications. With over 35 years of experience in short and ultrashort‑pulse laser technologies, Millux delivers precise, repeatable, and scalable results from feasibility studies through full production. The company specializes in machining complex micro‑features, creating high‑quality laser‑drilled structures, and producing reliable, contamination‑free welds on advanced metals such as titanium, stainless steels, Hastelloy, and aluminium. As part of the IDEX Materials Science Solutions platform, Millux is supported by a broader group with expertise in optical technologies, advanced metals, technical glass, and ceramics, enhancing its ability to solve complex engineering challenges. Role Description The New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineer is part of the Engineering team at Millux, which also consists of Factory Engineers, R&D engineers and Project leads. The team is lead by the Engineering manager. The NPI Engineer is responsible for driving new products from concept to stable series production in a on-site role based in Wijchen. This role includes liaising with clients regarding manufacturability, conducting parameter testing on machines, programming machines, creating prototypes and hand over projects to production. A versatile role with many responsibilities. The engineer collaborates closely with R&D, production, quality, and customer engineering teams to translate design requirements into robust, scalable processes and work instructions. Day-to-day tasks involve planning and tracking NPI projects, organizing and executing tests and trials, analyzing process data, and implementing improvements to ensure quality, yield, and on-time delivery. The role also includes preparing technical documentation, supporting customer technical reviews, and ensuring smooth handover of new products to operations. Working at Millux Millux has an open culture. Employees are ambitious, loyal, enthusiastic and supportive of one another. You will be welcomed as part of our team and will feel at home from the start. We work hard every day to achieve the best results and we celebrate successes together. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related technical discipline. 5-10 years experience in a similar role, preferably in an international environment. Strong analytical skills, including data interpretation, problem-solving, and root cause analysis. Research and Development (R&D) capabilities, such as experimental design, process optimization, and collaboration with product and process engineers. Project Management skills, including planning, organizing milestones, coordinating stakeholders, and managing timelines and resources. Product Development experience, including translating customer specifications into manufacturable solutions and supporting design-for-manufacturing activities. Testing skills, including defining test plans, executing trials, documenting results, and validating process robustness. Relevant experience in laser processing, precision manufacturing, or semiconductor/high‑tech environments. Strong communication skills, ability to work in cross-functional teams. Fluent or Native speaker in Dutch language and fluent in English are both manditory. What do we offer you? First and foremost, a highly collaborative and motivated work environment where your input can make a difference, with plenty of opportunities for training, personal development, and growth. We offer a competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. The Metalektro Collective Bargaining Agreement applies, and we also offer excellent employment benefits. These include: • Salary between € 4350 and € 6650 • 8% vacation pay • 27 vacation days + 13 scheduled days off • pension plan (PME) • profit-sharing bonus • option to lease a bicycle through Lease-a-bike.nl • contribution toward a gym membership through Bedrijfsfitness.nl We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or other external parties. Any resumes submitted without a valid service agreement and prior authorization will be considered the property of the company, and no placement fee will be paid.

title: Materials Engineer – Metallographer
description: We are looking for a Materials Engineer / Metallographer to join a laboratory team supporting advanced manufacturing, production, research, and development activities. The laboratory works across materials analysis, chemical laboratory testing, metallography, microscopy, and thermal spray technologies . The role involves investigating materials and processes, supporting production-related challenges, conducting damage and failure investigations, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. You will work closely with laboratory colleagues, engineers, production teams, and internal customers to deliver reliable material analysis and laboratory results. Key Responsibilities Perform sample preparation and material testing using cutting, mounting/casting, grinding, and polishing equipment. Prepare samples for metallographic and microscopic examination. Conduct and support microscopy investigations of metallographic, thermally sprayed, and additively manufactured/printed samples. Analyze and document examination results and prepare technical reports and laboratory documentation. Support material characterization, damage investigations, and problem-solving activities related to production and process development. Contribute to research and development of new materials and manufacturing processes. Work with colleagues across materials engineering, laboratory operations, and process development on continuous improvement initiatives. Support laboratory instrument development, IT systems, calibration, quality assurance, and process improvements. Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical laboratory solutions. Ensure laboratory activities are performed according to applicable quality, safety, and documentation requirements. Required Qualifications Technical education or professional background, preferably in Materials Technology, Materials Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related field. Practical interest in laboratory work, materials analysis, inspection, and testing environments. Basic understanding of metallography, microscopy, and material characterization techniques. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and standard IT tools. Ability to learn and work with laboratory information management systems and technical software. Good spoken and written English. Good spoken and written Swedish. Preferred / Meritorious Qualifications Hands-on experience with metallographic sample preparation. Experience working with microscopy and material examination equipment. Experience with thermal spray, additive manufacturing, coatings, or related manufacturing processes. Experience with laboratory systems, quality management, or laboratory documentation. Practical experience operating and maintaining laboratory instruments and equipment. Good mechanical aptitude and confidence working with cutting, grinding, polishing, and other workshop/laboratory equipment. Personal Attributes We are looking for someone who: Takes individual responsibility and can work independently while contributing effectively to a team. Has a structured and analytical approach to problem solving and investigations. Is comfortable communicating with colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders. Can understand customer requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. Is organized and able to deliver tasks according to agreed plans, priorities, and deadlines. Has a genuine interest in materials science, laboratory technology, and continuous improvement. Contributes to a positive, collaborative, and professional working environment.

title: INGENIEUR INDUSTRIALISATION H/F
description: À propos de nous C'est en intervenant depuis plus de 20 ans sur des projets majeurs et toujours plus complexes que nous encourageons le dépassement de soi afin de relever les défis techniques de grands donneurs d'ordres dans les secteurs de l'aérospatial, des énergies, de la défense, du naval, du ferroviaire ou encore du sport automobile. AVANTIS résulte d'une envie profonde de ses créateurs d'être une véritable référence dans le domaine de l'ingénierie mécanique. Nos équipes, composées d'experts passionnés et dévoués sont le moteur de notre entreprise et s'engagent à offrir à nos clients une expérience unique, basée sur la qualité et la fiabilité de notre savoir-faire. En tant qu'acteur important du développement de solutions innovantes, nous accompagnons aujourd'hui les leaders des industries de pointe. Bâtir une relation durable et garantir la satisfaction de nos clients avec une technologie innovante et une exigence qualité, tels sont les objectifs des 300 collaborateurs du groupe. Ensemble, nous nous efforçons de développer des relations authentiques et durables, fondées sur la confiance, le respect et la transparence. Dans un monde où les défis sont nombreux et complexes, nous croyons fermement que la capacité à penser de manière créative et à innover est essentielle pour réussir. Rejoindre AVANTIS, c'est la possibilité d'imaginer la conception de solutions innovantes à partir d'une feuille blanche et aboutir à des résultats performants. Aujourd'hui, nos 11 sites en France et à l'étranger dont notre usine de fabrication et notre centre R&D nous permettent d'optimiser la conception et la fabrication de structures/pièces mécaniques et de réduire notre impact environnemental en intégrant tous les moyens de production permettant de réaliser les produits de A à Z. Nos bureaux d’études de Melun et Torcy en Seine-et-Marne, interviennent en tant que maitre d’œuvre sur des projets d’outillages, de bancs d’essais, de machines spéciales et d’équipements industriels dans les secteurs de l’aéronautique, du spatial, de la défense, du naval, du ferroviaire et des énergies. Nous assurons la conception, le dimensionnement, la définition, la réalisation et l’installation de tous ces moyens. Mission Dans la continuité du développement de notre activité nous recherchons : UN INGENIEUR INDUSTRIALISATION/MANUFACTURING H/F Vous interviendrez sur des projets liés à la fabrication de pièces et de composants pour des moteurs aéronautiques de type turbofan. Ce poste, à fort potentiel d’évolution, vous permettra de prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités sur des projets industriels stratégiques et complexes, tout en bénéficiant de réelles perspectives de développement et d’évolution de carrière. Intégré au sein d’un environnement technique exigeant et international, vous assurerez le suivi de l’industrialisation et de la fabrication de pièces à forte valeur ajoutée, depuis l’analyse des procédés jusqu’au suivi de leur réalisation et de leur conformité. A Ce Titre, Vous Aurez Pour Missions Principales Le pilotage et le suivi de l’industrialisation de pièces mécaniques complexes destinées aux moteurs aéronautiques ; Le suivi des différentes étapes et procédés de fabrication : forge (forging), fonderie (casting), usinage (machining), traitements thermiques, traitements de surface et revêtements ; Le suivi des procédés spéciaux associés à la fabrication : soudage, brasage, traitements spécifiques, CND/NDT ; La compréhension globale des autres procédés pouvant intervenir dans la fabrication de pièces moteurs : électroérosion (EDM), fabrication additive métallique, métrologie et contrôle dimensionnel ; L'analyse des dossiers de fabrication, gammes, plans, spécifications techniques et exigences qualité ; La participation aux différentes étapes de qualification et validation des procédés industriels ; L'identification des risques industriels et techniques et et le pilotage des plans d’actions associés ; L'analyse des non-conformités, la participation à la recherche des causes racines et la mise en œuvre les actions correctives ; Le suivi de l’avancement des activités avec les différents interlocuteurs : engineering, manufacturing, qualité, supply chain, fournisseurs et partenaires ; La participation aux revues techniques et industrielles afin d'assurer un reporting clair sur l’avancement, les risques et les points bloquants ; La contribution à l’amélioration continue des processus de fabrication et à la sécurisation de la performance industrielle. Profil Issu d'une formation supérieure de niveau BAC+5 (école d'ingénieurs ou université) à dominante mécanique, matériaux, procédés de fabrication, production ou industrialisation, vous justifiez idéalement d'environ 5 ans d'expérience dans un environnement industriel exigeant tels que l'aéronautique, les moteurs aéronautiques, la défense, les énergies ou la mécanique de haute précision. Vous Disposez D'une Bonne Compréhension Des Procédés De Fabrication De Pièces Mécaniques à Forte Valeur Ajoutée, Notamment Forge – Fonderie – Usinage – Traitements thermiques – Traitements de surface & revêtements – Procédés spéciaux – Soudage/brasage – CND/NDT – Métrologie – Fabrication additive. Une expertise approfondie de l'ensemble de ces procédés n'est pas indispensable. Nous recherchons avant tout un profil capable de comprendre une gamme de fabrication complexe, d'identifier les procédés et étapes critiques, d'analyser les risques industriels et de coordonner les actions nécessaires. Des connaissances en APQP, PPAP, FAI, AMDEC/FMEA, 8D, Root Cause Analysis ou démarches similaires constituent un atout. Un anglais de niveau B1 ou B2 est demandé. The project aims to develop an integrated computational design and digital fabrication workflow for next-generation footwear. The research combines biomechanics, computational design, mechanical metamaterials, additive manufacturing, and digital workflows to create novel footwear concepts with improved performance and manufacturability. One of the three positions will focus on mechanical metamaterials design. This researcher will develop computational methods and experimentally evaluate mechanical metamaterials for footwear applications. Responsibilities Design mechanical metamaterials for functional performance Perform computational modelling and simulation Prototype and experimentally characterise designs Optimise structures for manufacturability and performance Collaborate closely with the computational design and biomechanics researchers Job Requirements MSc (or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, or a closely related discipline Strong background in mechanics and finite element analysis Experience with topology optimisation and/or inverse design Experience with additive manufacturing or mechanical testing is an advantage Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ is desirable. TU Delft (Delft University of Technology) Working at TU Delft means contributing to solutions that really make a difference. For over 180 years, we have been training engineers who make an impact worldwide in companies, government bodies, or as entrepreneurs. Our alumni turn knowledge into concrete solutions for the challenges of today and tomorrow. These challenges are changing rapidly. That is why we focus on themes such as energy, climate, digitalisation, artificial intelligence (AI), and smart mobility every day. Our education and research are directly aligned with what society needs now and in the future. At TU Delft, our people make the difference. With their knowledge and curiosity, our staff provide a high-quality education and conduct pioneering research that extends beyond the campus. You will have the opportunity to take the initiative, work with others, and grow as a professional. Working at TU Delft means join an international community of professionals and students. Together, we create knowledge, innovations, and solutions that help move the world forward. Faculty Industrial Design Engineering Matching the evolution of people with the speed of the revolution of technology. This is the focus of the Faculty of Industrial Design Engineering (IDE). Delft designers act as a bridge between advances in technology and the needs of people, organisations and society to create products, services and systems with purpose. IDE is a leader in design research across the application areas of mobility, sustainability and health, as well as its development of design tools and methods. A 350-strong research team and over 2,000 students work together in our inspiring hall, labs and studios. In close cooperation with industry, the public sector and NGOs we rehearse possible futures in research and education to design for a complex future. Click here to go to the website of the Faculty of Industrial Design Engineering. Conditions of employment Duration of contract is 12 months. Temporary. A job of 32-36 hours per week. A salary based on scale 8 or 10 will be applicable and is depending on graduation date and years of relevant work experience after graduation. With a salary between €3537 - €5760 gross per month based on a fulltime contract (38 hours), plus 8% holiday allowance and an end-of-year bonus of 8.3%. An excellent pension scheme via the ABP. The possibility to compile an individual employment package every year. Discount with health insurers on supplemental packages. Flexible working week. Every year, 232 leave hours (at 38 hours). title: PhD Position Unravelling Hydrogen-Induced Degradation and Fracture in Circular Steels
description: Join a cutting-edge research programme at TU Delft and investigate the mechanisms of hydrogen-induced degradation in circular steels. Job Description Within this project, you will investigate one of the key challenges facing the hydrogen economy: understanding how hydrogen interacts with the complex microstructures of circular steels and causes degradation and failure. This position is part of the project "Circularity as Opportunity: Engineering Hydrogen-Resistant Circular Steels (CIRHY)", a 6-year research and innovation programme developing next-generation circular steels that can safely operate in hydrogen environments. By combining advanced experiments with multiscale modelling, CIRHY aims to enable reliable and sustainable steels for future hydrogen infrastructure and industry. Hydrogen embrittlement is one of the major barriers to the safe deployment of hydrogen technologies. At the same time, increasing steel circularity introduces microstructural complexity through tramp elements, precipitates, inclusions and segregation phenomena. While considerable progress has been made in understanding hydrogen embrittlement in conventional steels, the mechanisms governing hydrogen-induced degradation and fracture in compositionally complex circular steels remain poorly understood. The Extreme Materials and Mechanics Group at TU Delft, led by Prof. Vera Popovich, is internationally recognized for its expertise in hydrogen embrittlement, fracture mechanics and advanced characterization of metallic materials. By combining state-of-the-art microscopy, hydrogen testing and fracture mechanics, the group develops fundamental understanding of material degradation in extreme environments and translates this knowledge into solutions for the energy transition. Within this position, you will combine advanced microstructural characterization, in-situ hydrogen mechanical testing and fracture toughness experiments to uncover how hydrogen interacts with circular steel microstructures and affects deformation, ductility, crack initiation and crack propagation. You will investigate hydrogen trapping and transport, identify the microstructural features controlling embrittlement and establish quantitative links between microstructure and structural performance. The outcome of this research, conducted in close collaboration with Tata Steel and other partners, will provide crucial experimental insights for designing safer and more reliable hydrogen-resistant circular steels. Role In this role, you will develop fundamental insights into the mechanisms governing hydrogen-induced degradation and failure of circular steels. As a PhD researcher, you will: Perform advanced 3D microstructural characterization of circular steels, focusing on segregation of tramp elements to precipitates, inclusions, interfaces, voids and dislocations. Investigate the influence of hydrogen on deformation behaviour and ductility through in-situ hydrogen mechanical testing. Quantify hydrogen transport, trapping and interaction with microstructural defects using advanced characterization techniques. Conduct in-situ hydrogen fracture toughness testing to identify crack initiation and propagation mechanisms. Collaborate closely with researchers from the Department of Materials Science and Engineering at TU Delft, University of Groningen, Eindhoven University of Technology, University of Twente, KU Leuven, MPI for Sustainable Materials and multiple industrial partners. Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and dissemination activities within the M2i framework. Job Requirements We are looking for a highly motivated and curious researcher with a strong interest in materials degradation, hydrogen embrittlement and advanced experimental characterization. You enjoy working at the intersection of materials science, mechanics and microscopy, and are excited to contribute to the development of sustainable materials for the hydrogen economy. You are an independent thinker, eager to learn new experimental techniques, and enjoy collaborating with researchers from different disciplines as well as industrial partners. Furthermore, You Meet The Following Requirements You hold a Master's degree in Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Applied Physics, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline. You have a strong background in physical metallurgy, materials characterization, fracture mechanics, mechanical behaviour of materials, or a related field. Experience with one or more advanced characterization techniques such as SEM, EBSD, TEM, XRD, SIMS or related methods is highly desirable. Experience with mechanical testing, fracture mechanics, hydrogen embrittlement research or materials degradation is an advantage but not mandatory. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and enjoy combining experimental observations with scientific interpretation. You have a strong academic track record, demonstrated by excellent study results and/or research experience. You are enthusiastic about working in a multidisciplinary academic and industrial consortium. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi
description: MEKANİK TASARIM MÜHENDİSİ İlan Hakkında HARPAX Sistem Teknolojileri, hava, kara ve deniz platformlarına yönelik kritik alt sistemlerin geliştirilmesi alanında faaliyet gösteren bir mühendislik şirketidir. ODTÜ Teknokent ofisimize, havacılık yakıt ve yağlama ekipmanları başta olmak üzere, elektro-mekanik alt sistemlerin, gereksinimden doğrulamaya kadar uzanan ürün geliştirme süreçlerine liderlik edecek, çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. İş Tanımı • Üst seviye sistem gereksinimlerini alt seviye mekanik tasarım gereksinimlerine dönüştürmek, tasarıma eksiksiz aktarmak ve doğrulama aşamasına kadar izlenebilirliğini sağlamak. • Literatür, standart ve pazar araştırmalarını yürüterek kavramsal tasarım, teknoloji geliştirme, prototipleme ve tasarım olgunlaştırma faaliyetlerini gerçekleştirmek. • İleri seviye 3B modelleme, 2B teknik resim hazırlama, Geometrik Ölçümlendirme ve Toleranslandırma (GD&T) ile tolerans yığılım (stack-up) analizlerini yürütmek. • Üretim ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak Üretilebilirlik) ve Montajlanabilirlik değerlendirmelerini yapmak; tasarımları performans, güvenilirlik, ağırlık, maliyet ve çevrim süresi ekseninde optimize etmek. • Yapısal, akış ve termal analizlerin gerçekleştirilmesi amacı ile analiz ekipleriyle gerekli girdi ve çıktıların belirlenmesinde rol almak, analiz çıktıları mekanik tasarıma yansıtmak. • Çevresel ve fonksiyonel tasarım doğrulama testlerini test ekipleriyle birlikte yürütmek; testlerde gözlenen uyumsuzlukların kök neden analizlerini (RCA) yaparak tasarım düzeltici faaliyetlerini sonuçlandırmak. • Ürün Ağacı (BOM), Arayüz Kontrol Dokümanı (ICD), malzeme tanımları, montaj talimatları ve tasarım doğrulama raporlarını hazırlamak ve güncelliğini sağlamak. • Tasarım ve değişiklik yönetim süreçlerini kurumsal konfigürasyon, kalite standartları ve havacılık prosedürlerine uygun yürütmek. • Sistem, analiz, test, üretim, kalite, tedarik zinciri ve alt yükleniciler arasındaki teknik koordinasyonu sağlamak; iç ve dış paydaşlara teknik sunumlar gerçekleştirmek. Aranan Nitelikler • Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, Havacılık ve Uzay Mühendisliği, Uçak Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun (Tercihen yüksek lisans derecesine sahip). • Mekanik tasarım ve ürün geliştirme süreçlerinde en az 5 yıl sektör tecrübesi olan. • Tercihen pompa, döner ekipman, yakıt/yağlama sistemleri, hidrolik-pnömatik komponentler veya hassas mekanik mekanizmaların tasarımında doğrudan rol almış. • İleri düzeyde 3B parametrik modelleme ve teknik resim bilgisi (Tercihen CATIA V5/V6 tecrübesi; 3DEXPERIENCE veya benzeri PLM platformlarına hakimiyet). • Havacılık malzemeleri, makine elemanları, standart imalat yöntemleri, yüzey ve ısıl işlem süreçleri ile GD&T (ASME Y14.5 / ISO-GPS) standartlarına hakim. • Yapısal (FEA), termal veya hesaplamalı akışkanlar dinamiği (CFD) temel prensiplerini bilen ve analiz çıktılarını yorumlayabilen (Tercihen ANSYS deneyimi). • Havacılık kalifikasyon ve çevresel test standartlarına (MIL-STD-810, RTCA DO-160 vb.) aşina olmak, • Uluslararası literatürü, teknik standartları takip edebilecek ve raporlama/sunum yapabilecek düzeyde ileri teknik İngilizce bilgisi. • Güçlü analitik düşünme, sistematik problem çözme (kök neden analizi) ve çok disiplinli ekiplerle etkin çalışma/iletişim kabiliyeti. • Seyahat engeli bulunmayan, Ankara'da ikamet eden/edebilecek ve erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış ya da muaf.

title: Research, Simulations
description: Employment type: Full time - Hybrid Compensation: 250.000 – 500.000 TL net per month · equity · private health insurance About Talp Talp is simulation infrastructure for enterprise decisions. We build a company’s customer base from its own behavioral data so decisions can be tested before they are made, and we already work with large enterprises across three regions. We are the wind tunnel for decisions. What we install stays and sharpens every time it runs, which is why we call it infrastructure rather than a tool. Testing decisions this way will soon be as ordinary as version control. We have raised $2.2 million to date, most recently at a $25 million valuation, from Formus Capital, Sunshine Lake Ventures, Aito Capital, the a16z Scout Fund, and a group of GPs and founders. The Role Everyone in this field renders the simulation. Nobody renders the proof. Confidence scores, calibration methods, benchmarks measured against human evidence. None of it has been published by anyone in this category, and the company that publishes it first will define how everybody else gets measured. That is the center of this job. You will participate in shaping our scientific direction and turn research into working systems. Your scope spans modeling, evaluation, and the infrastructure that supports experimentation and deployment. This is a hands-on role. You will design experiments, write code, inspect data, and work closely with engineering. You should be comfortable asking difficult scientific questions and taking full responsibility for how they are answered. Responsibilities Shape the research direction: Identify the most valuable questions, prioritize experiments, and connect scientific progress directly to product improvements. Develop and improve models: Work across data preparation, model adaptation, training, and fine-tuning. Reproduce relevant research, challenge its assumptions, and test approaches against strong alternatives. Define how quality is measured: Design benchmarks and experiments that assess behavioral accuracy, consistency, and usefulness. Compare simulations against human evidence while accounting for uncertainty, population variance, and data limitations. Build reliable evaluation systems: Develop repeatable workflows for comparing models, investigating failures, and detecting regressions. Keep datasets, experiments, and results strictly traceable, protecting evaluation data from leaking into development. Combine human and automated judgment: Create clear scoring criteria, review processes, and automated evaluators, then verify that those evaluators consistently agree with qualified human reviewers. Make research practical to run: Partner with engineering on data pipelines, experiment tracking, training workflows, and model serving to maximize iteration speed, reliability, and compute efficiency. Carry improvements into production: Follow promising results through implementation and deployment, verifying that their advantages hold outside the original experiment. Set the scientific standard: Establish clear standards for rigor, and communicate findings through technical writing, publications, and external collaborations. Who You Are Applied Research Record: A strong track record in applied AI or machine learning research, with evidence of taking ideas from experiments into working production systems. Deep Model Experience: Hands-on experience with language models, modern training/fine-tuning techniques, and rigorous model evaluation. Core Engineering Skills: Strong Python skills and deep familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. Sound Statistical Judgment: You reason intuitively about sampling, uncertainty, and bias, and can tell immediately whether an apparent improvement is statistically meaningful. Systems & Tooling Ownership: Experience building or owning research tooling, evaluation pipelines, or ML infrastructure that other engineers rely on. High Agency: The ability to drive technical work autonomously and make clear decisions even when the empirical evidence is incomplete. Intellectual Honesty: Clear communication and the willingness to discard an approach the moment the data challenges it. Typically five or more years of relevant AI or ML research experience. Relevant academic research counts toward this; we also welcome candidates with exceptional demonstrated impact on a shorter timeline. Valuable Additional Experience Behavioral science, computational social science, causal inference, or experimental design Synthetic data generation, human feedback loops, annotation systems, or complex behavioral datasets Multi-agent systems and simulations involving interacting populations Distributed training, GPU optimization, or efficient model serving You do not need equal depth in every area. We look for deep research instincts combined with strong engineering ability. A PhD is welcome but not required. Our Process We prioritize thoughtful conversations and clear examples of past work. Our hiring process is designed to help both sides align on mutual fit, working style, and expectations. Reapplication Policy: To ensure a fair and thorough evaluation for all applicants, Talp observes a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. Equal Opportunity Talp is an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of every background and identity. If you need support or an accommodation at any point in the process, let us know and we will arrange it.

Au sein de Fives Xcella, et sous la direction du Responsable BE, vous intégrerez l’équipe du Bureau d’Etudes Mécaniques. Si c’est vous, rejoignez-nous ! En rejoignant Fives, vous intégrerez un groupe international qui vous donnera accès à de multiples opportunités d’évolution et de mobilité, et ce, dans de nombreux domaines. Nous vous offrirons toute la place pour apprendre, grandir et vous épanouir, sur le plan professionnel, notamment grâce à nos programmes d’intégration et d’accompagnement, mais également sur le plan personnel. En effet, vous pourrez bénéficier d’un mode de travail hybride et de nombreux autres avantages [aide au logement, mutuelle, tickets restaurants, etc.]. Au travers de ses recrutements, Fives Xcella cultive une politique en faveur de la diversité, de l'égalité professionnelle et de l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés. Alors, rejoignez l’industrie qu’on aime !

title: Ingénieur(e) calcul en mécanique des structures H/F/D F/H
description: Travaillant au sein de l’équipe « Technology » de l’ingénierie Produit, l’ingénieur(e) calcul pour l’intégrité mécanique devra réaliser des études statiques et dynamiques des composants et assemblages des produits nucléaires, et contribuera au développement des outils et méthodes associés. Les produits nucléaires incluent la turbine à vapeur, les échangeurs thermiques, l’alternateur, les pompes et leurs systèmes auxiliaires. Ce rôle consiste principalement à évaluer l’intégrité mécanique de produits nucléaires (turbine, alternateur, pompes, échangeurs de chaleur, etc.) et à développer des méthodes et outils pour les analyses d’intégrité mécanique statique, dynamique et thermomécanique. Les principales activités sont les suivantes : Réaliser des analyses d’intégrité mécanique par la méthode des éléments finis sur des composants, conformément aux critères de dimensionnement et aux règles et instructions internes. Modéliser des structures complexes à l’aide du logiciel de maillage HyperMesh et effectuer des simulations par éléments finis sous ANSYS. Personnaliser les modèles, automatiser les cas de charge et effectuer des post-traitements avancés à l’aide du langage APDL (Ansys Parametric Design Language). Réaliser des analyses statiques et dynamiques (modales, sismiques, harmoniques, transitoires), ainsi que des études de durée de vie (fatigue, nocivité, propagation de fissures). Effectuer des calculs mécaniques linéaires et non linéaires (non-linéarités de contact, de comportement matériau et de géométrie). Intégrer les exigences des codes (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M) dans les études de dimensionnement des appareils à pression. Prendre en charge les analyses mécaniques dans le cadre de l’exécution des projets et/ou du développement produit. Rédiger les rapports d’analyse d’intégrité mécanique conformément aux exigences qualité et aux plannings définis. Vérifier les calculs et analyses réalisés par d’autres membres de l’équipe. Assurer le suivi technique des activités sous-traitées. Contribuer au développement et à l’harmonisation des outils, processus de calcul et à la capitalisation du savoir-faire. Respecter les règles et instructions EHS propres à l’entreprise. Diplôme d’ingénieur ou doctorat dans le domaine du calcul d’intégrité mécanique. Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine du calcul mécanique de structures par éléments finis. Excellente maîtrise des outils ANSYS (APDL) et HyperMesh ; la connaissance de CATIA est un atout. Bonne connaissance des codes et standards applicables aux appareils à pression (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M). Connaissance des machines tournantes Capacité à lire, analyser et interpréter des plans de fabrication et des documents d’ingénierie. Aptitude à travailler dans un environnement motivant et exigeant. Leadership et capacité à piloter des activités techniques complexes. Bon relationnel, esprit d’équipe et capacité à représenter le service dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements occasionnels en France ou à l’étranger (principalement en Europe). Bon niveau d’anglais.

description: L'entreprise QUI SOMMES NOUS ? CLEEVEN , cabinet de conseil en ingénierie à dimension internationale, s'est construit autour de 2 éléments extrêmement forts : Notre MISSION : Augmenter le degré de conscience de soi et de ceux qui nous entourent. En tant qu'ingénieurs, nous participons activement aux côtés de nos clients à assurer leur compétitivité mondiale. ÇA BOUGE CHEZ CLEEVEN ! Suivis de projet : Suivi mensuel avec votre ingénieur responsable sur le déroulement du projet. Boost your skills : Événements qui ont lieu tous les deux mois sur un des domaines d’expertise des consultants Cleeven. Soirées/Déjeuners conviviaux : Événements ayant lieu tout au long de l’année dans le but de renforcer l’esprit de cohésion et le partage entre consultants Cleeven. « Avec Cleeven, devenez qui vous êtes ! » Poste et mission Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités en bureau d'études R&D et calcul, nous renforçons nos équipes et recrutons un Ingénieur Structure . Vous participez à la conception, la modélisation, la simulation numérique et la justification de structures mécaniques complexes dans des environnements exigeants et innovants. Vos responsabilités principales sont : Recueillir et analyser les cahiers des charges techniques, les contraintes de tenue mécanique (statique, dynamique, fatigue) ainsi que les normes applicables aux structures. Planifier, réaliser et optimiser les prédimensionnements analytiques et les calculs de structures avancés en respectant les objectifs de poids, coût, sécurité et délais. Assurer l’interface entre les différents intervenants : concepteurs CAO, architectes systèmes, responsables R&D, essayeurs et clients. Participer à la définition des hypothèses de calcul, des maillages, des critères de résistance des matériaux (métalliques et/ou composites) et des dossiers de justification. Animer les revues de conception et de calcul , rédiger les notes de synthèse mécanique et assurer le reporting auprès des parties prenantes. Identifier les zones critiques , analyser les modes de ruine/défaillance et proposer des solutions de réconception ou de renforcement adaptées. Suivre les budgets de masse , les délais d'études et les jalons de livraison des dossiers de calcul. Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des méthodologies de calcul, des scripts d'automatisation (Python, Tcl) et des outils de simulation. Accompagner les phases d'essais physiques , en participant à la corrélation calculs/essais (extensométrie, vibrations) pour recaler les modèles numériques. Veiller au respect des normes de calcul sectorielles (Eurocodes, RCC-M, CS-25, FAR 25, ISO, etc.) et des exigences de qualité. Profil Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation Ingénieur en Mécanique, Calcul de Structures ou Simulation Numérique (ou d’un Bac +5 équivalent), et vous justifiez d’une première expérience réussie en calcul de structure ou en bureau d'études mécanique. Vous interviendrez sur des projets variés et stratégiques : structures aéronautiques, sous-ensembles automobiles, équipements sous pression, structures navales, spatiales ou ferroviaires. Les compétences principalement recherchées sont notamment : Calcul & Simulation (FEA/MEF) : Maîtrise de l'analyse par éléments finis (statique linéaire/non-linéaire, dynamique, flambement, fatigue, séisme/vibrations). Outils de Calcul & CAO : Pratique courante des logiciels de maillage et solveurs majeurs tels que ANSYS, Nastran, Patran, Abaqus, HyperMesh, OptiStruct ou Femap, ainsi que d'outils CAO (CATIA V5/3DEXPERIENCE, Creo, SolidWorks). Matériaux & RDM : Solides connaissances en résistance des matériaux (RDM), mécanique de la rupture, caractérisation des alliages métalliques et des composites. Communication : Rigueur rédactionnelle pour la création des notes de calcul, clarté dans la restitution des résultats et aisance dans l'échange transverse avec les équipes CAO et R&D. Analyse et organisation : Esprit critique face aux résultats de simulation, pragmatisme, résolution de problèmes complexes et respect des échéances projet. Un bon niveau d’ anglais professionnel est requis pour intervenir sur nos projets internationaux. Venez vivre l’expérience au sein d’une société dynamique et innovante !

title: Structures Analysis Engineer, Launch Vehicle Structure (m/f/d)
description: Mission Brief You will be responsible for the structural analysis of entire assemblies belonging to our rocket’s primary and secondary structures. From trading design concepts to sizing and validating design iterations and examining the impact of manufacturing deviations, you will play an important role in guiding design decisions and pushing performance and reliability of our structures forward. As a Mid-Level Structures Analysis Engineer, you will support the analysis, verification and development of launch vehicle structures throughout the entire lifecycle, from concept to qualification. Your Role in Our Space Mission: Perform detailed stress analysis of aerospace structures and components using both classical hand calculations and advanced finite element methods (FEM), mostly of CFRP structures. Identify failure scenarios and collaborate with design engineers to review and optimize structural designs. Define applicable load cases, addressing the impact of thermal, quasi-static loads (arising from random vibrations) etc. Analise and provide possible solutions to manufacturing non-conformities. Develop test plans and support physical testing of components to verify sizing assumptions and qualify hardware. Prepare comprehensive stress analysis reports and documentation for internal/external use. Improve our standards and toolchain for structural verification. Be familiar with classical design standards and have experience in the use of CAD software Operate independently with moderate guidance. Qualification Checklist Degree in the field of Engineering, Aerospace, Mechanical or (Computational) Mechanics, or any other related field. At least 3 years of experience in analysing aerospace structures. Good knowledge in classical hand-calculations and advanced FE Modelling of aerospace structures (Hypermesh, Optistruct, Nastran etc). Self-motivated, collaborative, and capable of working independently with moderate guidance. Good engineering intuition with regards to load paths and failure mechanisms. Strong teamwork skills to contribute to team goals and support large projects, including interaction with other departments. Fluent English Bonus Skills Practical experience in the space sector (preferably in launch vehicle development program). Previous experience using CAD, preferably with Siemens NX. Good understanding of composite structures’ behaviour over a wide range of temperatures. Practical experience with Material Qualification and composite manufacturing techniques. title: MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. We want you as a talented MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer to help us in our mission by contributing significantly to Additive Manufacturing (AM) technology, development and in-house production for our Vehicles Nyx Earth and Nyx Moon. The ideal candidate will play a key role as an MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer, working on the development and qualification of additive manufacturing (AM) processes, including the definition of print parameters for new materials. This role will also involve supporting the certification of AM components to comply with high industry standards, including NASA regulations. Role Overview As an MAIT Additive Manufacturing Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, qualification, and industrialization of Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF) technologies for critical aerospace hardware. You will support the full lifecycle of aerospace hardware, from manufacturability assessment and process development through qualification, certification, and production readiness. Working closely with Design Engineering, Materials & Processes, Quality, Testing, and Manufacturing teams, you will contribute to the delivery of flight-ready components across TEC's propulsion and space systems programs. This is a technically demanding role with direct impact on flight hardware development, manufacturing capability, and future production scalability. Key Responsibilities Own the manufacturing and qualification of mission-critical flight hardware. Develop, optimize, and qualify LPBF processes for a range of high-performance alloys. Define and manage material characterization campaigns, support test execution, and analyze the resulting data. Take over build preparation, LPBF process simulation, and process monitoring data analysis. Execute qualification and certification activities for AM hardware in accordance with aerospace requirements and internal quality processes. Troubleshoot manufacturing challenges and drive continuous improvement in process capability, quality, productivity, and inspection methodologies. Author technical documentation and collaborate with internal teams, external suppliers, laboratories, and certification bodies. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Aerospace Engineering, or related field. Hands-on experience with metal LPBF systems in an industrial environment. Experience in LPBF process development, material and part verification. Knowledge in material characterization methodologies, including the selection and interpretation of material property and mechanical testing data. Proficiency in CAD for part design modification, LPBF build design, and support generation. Experience with Siemens NX and PLM tools such as Teamcenter is a plus. Strong communication, analytical problem-solving, and effective collaboration across multidisciplinary and international teams. Fluent in English. Preferred Qualifications 3+ years of experience in LPBF process and hardware qualification for complex aerospace propulsion systems. Strong understanding of DFAM principles, LPBF process physics and parameters. Familiarity with aerospace materials such as nickel-based superalloys, titanium alloys, copper alloys, as well as stainless steels. Refractory alloys is a plus. Hands-on experience in machine operation, material characterization, including metallography, microstructural characterization, and mechanical testing. Proficiency in additive manufacturing process simulation solutions. Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable. All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible. If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Newly graduated Mechanical Engineers at Novo Nordisk Engineering
description: Does the idea of using your mechanical expertise to help build the world’s largest pharmaceutical facilities excite you? And do you thrive on tackling complex challenges and developing with each new task in a dynamic project environment? Then you’ll fit right in! Who We Are We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere. Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you. About The Role We are looking for newly graduated mechanical engineers, marine engineers or related educational backgrounds to ensure that our customers get the best-in-class mechanical consultancy in their projects ranging from conceptual design up until installation and commissioning. You will be a part of a highly skilled and supportive team of more than 280 colleagues across our 8 mechanical departments where you will work on large-scale projects currently in the production phase that will challenge and develop your skills. Why do we need you? Our aim is to assist our customers in establishing efficient, sustainable and intelligent facilities for API production. Your role will be crucial in delivering top-notch mechanical consultancy, ensuring our customers receive the best possible service. It is therefore essential that you have the ability to gain a broad understanding of mechanical engineering principles and to have a keen interest in the pharmaceutical industry to excel in this role Location Denmark - Kalundborg Experience Graduate level Department Mechanical KA II How You Might Spend Your Days As a newly graduated Mechanical Engineer, you’ll be: Specifying and dimensioning mechanical equipment, piping systems and technical components Supporting installation, construction and commissioning activities on large-scale pharmaceutical projects Participating in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) Collaborating with contractors, suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams Contributing to technical assessments and problem-solving throughout project execution Who You Are We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you are: Thrive in a dynamic project environment where priorities can evolve as projects progress Communicate clearly with colleagues, customers and stakeholders Take a structured and organised approach to your work Are curious and motivated to continuously learn and develop your technical skills Are positive, resilient and solution-oriented when facing challenges What You Bring To The Role In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role: You have recently graduated, or expect to graduate within the next six months, with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or a related technical discipline Through studies, projects, hobbies or practical experience, you have developed an interest in mechanical equipment and technical systems You are comfortable working in a highly regulated environment where quality, documentation and traceability are key You are fluent in written and spoken English Life at NNE NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more. At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs. We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth. You can read more about the benefits we offer here . Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you. Deadline of application is 15 October 2026 Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact on or Lars Lundberg Kristensen at +45 3075 8534. Please note: We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV We invite to interviews on a running basis. Fair hiring At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV. Still searching for the right opportunity? If this position isn’t quite what you're looking for, but you know someone who would excel in this role, please share this job post. And don’t forget to explore our other exciting opportunities — your future role at NNE might be just around the corner! Visit our Career Site

title: Junior mechanical engineer
description: Ontwerp wat beweegt, tilt en draait Als junior mechanical engineer werk je aan techniek die letterlijk in beweging is. Denk aan containerkranen van honderd meter hoog, het beweegbare dak van de Johan Cruijff ArenA of offshore windplatforms midden op zee. Jij ontwerpt en rekent aan onderdelen die onder zware omstandigheden moeten blijven functioneren. Binnen infra en water werk je aan beweegbare bruggen, sluizen, gemalen en waterzuiveringen. Je ontwerpt aandrijvingen en bewegingswerken die elke dag betrouwbaar moeten functioneren. In offshoreprojecten werk je aan hijsvoorzieningen en mechanische onderdelen van windplatforms. Binnen de industrie ontwerp je constructies voor fabrieken en procesinstallaties. En in de maritieme sector werk je mee aan de mechanica van onderzeeboten en marineschepen. Je werkt ontwerpen uit van concept tot detail. Je maakt berekeningen op sterkte, stijfheid en vermoeiing, toetst aan normen en denkt mee over maakbaarheid en onderhoud. Je stemt af met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines zoals civiele techniek, elektrotechniek en procestechnologie. Je ziet hoe jouw ontwerp onderdeel wordt van een groter geheel. Bij Iv werken we aan projecten die anderen soms voor onmogelijk houden. We houden van ingewikkelde vraagstukken, maar niet van moeilijk doen. De lijnen zijn kort, de lat ligt hoog en je krijgt snel verantwoordelijkheid. Je start met begeleiding, maar groeit snel door naar zelfstandige taken. Wil je je verdiepen in ontwerp, modelleren of juist richting projectcoördinatie? Dan krijg je daar de ruimte voor. Jouw ambitie bepaalt je route. Wat verwachten we van jou? Hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde Interesse in maritiem, offshore, gebouwen of infraprojecten Analytisch sterk en zorgvuldig Goede communicatieve vaardigheden Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands Wat hebben we jou te bieden? Een uitdagende en gevarieerde baan bij het meest diverse ingenieursbureau van Nederland! Zo kun je rekenen op: De gaafste projecten in alle sectoren: je werkt aan hoogwaardige oplossingen waar de maatschappij écht iets aan heeft. Van ’s werelds grootste offshore windplatformen, bruggen en sluizen tot fabrieken, waterzuiveringsinstallaties en onderzeeboten. Een professionele én gezellige werkomgeving: bij Iv vind je een laagdrempelige werksfeer waarin hard werken hand in hand gaat met plezier. Zo bezoeken we tweejaarlijks het EK- of WK-voetbal, vieren we nieuwjaar groots in de Efteling, organiseren we gezellige zomerbarbecues en nog veel meer! Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden: kies voor meer salaris, extra vakantiedagen of beide! Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden: 31 vakantiedagen, jaarlijkse gratificatie (7%), winstuitkering, flexibele pensioenregeling en reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding. Ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden: we bieden talloze mogelijkheden tot het volgen van opleidingen, cursussen en trainingen om nóg beter te worden in je vak. Kortom: bij Iv werk je samen met 1400 andere specialisten aan de grootste uitdagingen van deze tijd én beleef je veel plezier. Dat noemen wij: engineering that excites.
